name: @lmthing/dsh-client-brand
description: LMThing branding for the dsh web UI (Part B, see dsh/PROGRESS.md) — replaces the shipped logo/wordmark slots with LMThing's own mark, and overrides the primary accent color to LMThing's design-system tokens (@lmthing/css tokens.json: primary #15505c light / #6aa8b4 dark). Host half is a no-op (exists so the row is an 'enabled Loader entry'); the browser half does the real work.
